{{Quote|Step up, brave Ewoks, and see what's inside. Garth, the snake eater.|Horville|<ref name="Hut" />}}
'''Garth''' was an individual with [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] who worked at the [[Horville's Hut of Horrors]] attraction on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="Hut" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date note">{{EwoksDate|appearance of Garth|[[Horville's Hut of Horrors (episode)|Horville's Hut of Horrors]]}}</ref> Garth was working as a [[Snake/Legends|snake]] [[Diet/Legends|eater]] at the hut when a group of [[Youngling/Legends|young]] [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] came to visit the attraction.<ref name="Hut" />

[[Horville]], the owner of the attraction, called for the Ewoks to step inside and take a look at what he had to offer. He gestured to Garth, who hissed as several snakes protruded from Garth's [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]]. The Ewoks found the display frightening and screamed. Later that [[Standard day/Legends|day]], when the Ewok [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] found himself covered in [[sugar leaf taffy]], the [[Wokling/Legends|wokling]] [[Malani]] equivalated his appearance to that of Garth. The reminder of Garth made the Ewoks burst into tears.<ref name="Hut" />

Later that night, one of the woklings had a [[Dream/Legends|nightmare]] featuring Garth. However, the wokling did not experience the dream as it was dispersed by a [[dream sucking device]].<ref name="Hut" />

==Behind the scenes==
Garth appeared in "[[Horville's Hut of Horrors (episode)|Horville's Hut of Horrors]],"<ref name="Hut" /> the sixteenth episode in the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]. The episode was written by [[Paul Dini]] and premiered on [[November 15]], [[1986]].<ref name="Insider 27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
